decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a further development of the established BASIC 518 trommel screen, so it builds directly on the firm's core screening know-how and its own development work, which lets management interpret results and keep refining it.
The AK flail shredder series sits at the heart of the firm's mobile shredding expertise and was actively updated to EU Stage V engines in 2019, showing continued investment and learning.

Although a sister green-waste grinder was withdrawn, this mobile high-speed grinder gained its own page in 2019 and lies close to the firm's core comminution knowledge, so management can assimilate feedback and improve it.

The CERON stationary single-shaft pre-shredder generation builds on long shredding experience, is promoted as setting benchmarks, and has reference installations in combined plants, which fits the firm's push towards plant solutions.
